text:
maria: Quick sync — sketching a lightweight 'confidence gate' that preemptively fails traffic to baseline or a smaller variant if combined quality/latency signals cross thresholds. sharing a minimal config proto below. Thoughts?

kevin: Love the idea. Quick q: how do you define 'confidence' here? raw model probs, eval pass rates, or something else? we need a clear telemetry contract.

maria: Mixed signals. plan is to aggregate: calibrated model confidence, eval-suite sliding pass rate (per-prompt-set), and latency tail. weight them into a score. proto snippet:```json
{
  "gate_id": "conf_v1",
  "window_s": 60,
  "signals": [
    {"name":"calibrated_confidence","weight":0.45,"threshold":0.6},
    {"name":"eval_pass_rate","weight":0.35,"threshold":0.85},
    {"name":"latency_p99_ms","weight":0.2,"threshold":1200}
  ],
  "actions": ["route_baseline","downscale_variant","notify_sre"],
  "cooldown_s": 120
}
```

sophie: From product POV we need per-customer overrides, a human-readable fallback reason surfaced in the rollout UI, and linkage to the rollout timeline so PMs can trace why traffic moved.

ryan: ML note — raw softmax probs are not comparable across models. we must attach per-model calibration profiles (or use a normalized z-score) before feeding into the gate. otherwise false positives.

ashley: SRE: latency tail triggers should be strict. If p99 > 2s for >1% of requests in the window => immediate fallback. Also require exponential backoff on re-enable to avoid thrash. Also audit events for every decision.

kevin: Implementation question — should the gate be a synchronous RPC the router calls (fast path) or an async signal that influences routing heuristics? my preference: sync decision with tiny timeout (<=1ms) returning {decision,reason,sticky_ttl_s}. keep it cheap.

maria: We were imagining the router owning the decision for latency reasons, with a local cache of recent gate state. Policy evaluation can run in a lightweight wasm/wasm-like sandbox at the router. async probes update the cached state. decision API shape as kevin suggested is good.

deploy-bot: deploy: config conf_v1 pushed to staging clusters by @maria :rocket:

maria: :thumbsup: I'll draft an RFC with the policy proto, telemetry schema, and default weights. need owners for the metrics shape (histograms + gauge tags).

ashley: I'll take telemetry ownership. suggestion: emit these tags on spans: gate_id, decision, reason, model_variant, tenant_id, p99_ms_bucket. also an event sink for 'fallback_executed'.

ryan: action idea — prefer graceful degrade over full rollback: add action "downscale_variant:quantized-8bit" so we keep functionality while reducing cost/latency. include a safety check on quality delta.

sophie: Also add a per-tenant emergency kill-switch exposed in Console (with audit and 2FA) — some customers will want manual fail-open or fail-closed for compliance.

kevin: Noted. we'll add per-tenant override flags + rate-limited emergency rollback API. router will consult tenant overrides first.

maria: Next steps: I'll produce RFC + example rollout that uses the gate for a canary -> gradual -> full migration flow. @ashley @kevin @ryan please review the RFC draft today. meeting to align tomorrow 11:00am.

ashley: ack, will review.

kevin: ack.

ryan: ack.

sophie: thanks, will prep product acceptance criteria.
